categories.main_business_segments: Easou Technology Holdings Limited operates four primary business lines: online reading platform services, digital marketing services, online games publishing services, and other digital content services. Over 90% of revenue is generated from advertising services within the online reading platform and digital marketing segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technology is its proprietary AI-based Easou Recommendation Engine, consisting of six layers, which powers personalized content recommendations across multiple scenarios including online reading, digital marketing, online games, and other digital content. The company continuously invests in R&D to enhance this engine, incorporating large model technology, multimodal feature fusion, and AI-generated content (AIGC) technologies such as diffusion models for content and speech generation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Easou serves digital content providers, media channels, users, advertising customers, and telecommunications operators primarily in Mainland China. Its digital marketing services cater to advertisers seeking targeted ad placements, while the online reading platform targets end users with digital literature and short drama content. The company is expanding into overseas markets, focusing on European and American users for short drama content and overseas publishing of online games.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group’s operations and significant assets are concentrated in Mainland China, with headquarters in Shenzhen and offices in Hong Kong. The company is actively expanding its presence in overseas markets, particularly targeting Europe and North America for digital content and online games publishing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Easou operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital content supply chain, providing platform services that connect content providers, advertisers, and end users. It acts as a digital marketing service provider, content recommender, and online game publisher, facilitating content distribution and monetization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing its AI-based recommendation technology, leveraging large model and multimodal AI techniques to improve recommendation accuracy and efficiency. It is increasing investment in AIGC technologies for advertising creativity, literary creation, speech generation, and film and television content. Expansion into overseas markets and enhancement of digital marketing platform capabilities are key priorities for 2025.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through advertising services on its online reading platform and digital marketing services, accounting for over 90% of total revenue. Additional revenue streams include online games publishing and other digital content services such as music and video recommendations. The company also derives income from service fees under contractual arrangements with affiliated entities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Easou positions itself as a technology-driven AI recommendation platform with diversified digital content offerings. Its competitive edge lies in its proprietary AI recommendation engine and integrated platform connecting multiple digital content scenarios, aiming to build international competitiveness through overseas market expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2024, Easou reported revenue of RMB604.2 million, an 8.1% increase from 2023. The company recorded a slight loss before tax of RMB1.0 million in 2024 compared to a profit in 2023, reflecting investments and challenges in the gaming segment. Total assets grew 34.7% to RMB680.8 million, with equity increasing 17.5% to RMB445.7 million, supported by proceeds from its June 2024 IPO.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Easou emphasizes its AI-based recommendation technology as the foundation for delivering personalized and precise content recommendations across multiple digital content domains. Its platform integrates diverse content and participants, enabling cross-scenario synergy and diversified monetization. The company’s continuous R&D investment and application of advanced AI models differentiate its offerings by enhancing user experience and marketing conversion efficiency.
